summary: Fence thread history against older readers

replay.detail: Older readers keep signed marked messages in unknown-field quarantine. A compatible reader retries held messages using the existing replication backlog.

schema.detail: Local store open advances to version 22. Typed thread message claims carry a signed reader marker. Version-21 builds refuse a version-22 disk and hold newly exchanged marked messages.

rules.detail: Replication signatures and checkpoint semantics remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The complete reader accepts ordinary messages and marked thread messages. Unmarked thread messages from preview writers are refused on replication. Generic graph and stream events and generic status omit private thread messages. Earlier writer activation was limited to disposable environments.

downtime.detail: The local version advances during normal startup.

manual.detail: Deploy and verify complete readers before separately enabling thread writes.

recovery.detail: Recover with a version-22 reader. Use a pre-upgrade backup for a version-21 rollback before enabling thread writes.
